reviews.comment: Really nice professor, class is mainly reading outside of class and discussions in class. Grades by occasional simple reading quizzes, one group project, one day of leading discussion as a group, and a take-home writing final. Not a ton of work if you don't mind reading, picked good books. Overall pretty nice and understanding

I loved coming to this class. Such great times. Learning about 3 books about a sexually confused moor, a colonization impact sob story .It was so sad. There were so many like the professor highly impacted.And Dracula. Highly recommend. I love using this building to study its empty all the time. I loved her take on Marxism and Feminsim.

Professor Choi is so sweet! Her feedback on my essays was always really helpful and made me a better writer. The reading is heavy, but as long as you do your work (read sparknotes) and try on the essays, an A isn't too hard to get!

Jiwon Choi is one of the harshest graders at Texas A&M that I have encountered thus far. She is terrible at responding to emails and you will get little to no feedback on what you did wrong on assignments. The class is graded on a 1000 point scale. After receiving 898 pts, she refused to round me up TWO points to get an A in the course. Avoid her.
